module_title: Introduction to Agentic AI & Autonomous Tools
course_title: Introduction to Agentic AI & Autonomous Tools
description: Foundational instruction in agentic architecture: tool calling, ReAct loops, planning, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and human-in-the-loop autonomous execution.
learning_outcomes: Differentiate between single-turn prompt-response LLM interactions and multi-turn autonomous agent loops.
Implement schema-validated JSON tool definitions and handle tool-call responses in Python.
Trace and debug ReAct (Reason + Act) loop execution, stopping conditions, and error recovery.
Evaluate security boundaries, prompt injection risks, and deterministic constraints for autonomous agent actions.
